text:
sara: Quick sync — I'm drafting the PRD + rollout plan for the next model deployment (v2.1). Need owners, experiment design, pinning policy, and clear rollback criteria. Can we align on minimum acceptance criteria and timeline?

ajay: I can take infra + canary gating ownership. We need explicit traffic split, pin semantics (per-tenant vs global), and autoscale knobs called out.

li: Proposal for experiment arms: control (v2.0), pinned-v2.1 (tenants pinned to v2.1 but otherwise no swap), full-swap (traffic routed to v2.1). Key metrics: latency p95, token cost/unit, quality eval delta on our regression set, and user-facing error rate.

ben: For quality sig tests we'll need daily sample sizes — ballpark: 50k requests per arm to detect ~1% deltas on top-level metrics. Also track cohorted metrics by prompt type.

marta: SLOs to enforce during canary: p95 latency < 300ms and infra error rate < 1%. Rollback trigger: error budget burn > 5% over 10 minutes OR p95 > 300ms sustained for 5m. Also require full telemetry for pinned tenants (no sampling gaps).

ajay: Drafting rollout config snippet to capture the idea:
```json
{
  "arms": [
    {"name":"control","weight":50,"model":"v2.0"},
    {"name":"pinned","weight":25,"model":"v2.1","pin":"tenant"},
    {"name":"swap","weight":25,"model":"v2.1"}
  ],
  "rollback_triggers": ["p95_latency>300ms","error_rate>0.01","quality_regression>1%"],
  "pin_ttl_hours": 72
}
```

sara: Acceptance criteria to include in PRD: no >1% regression on our eval sets, p95 latency within SLO, end-to-end observability enabled in Console (per-route dashboards), and an approved runbook for rollback and tenant unpinning.

marta: Add automatic pin expiry: pinned tenants must fall back after TTL (72h) unless SRE/PM explicitly extends. Manual override permitted via runbook with audit log.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary window 2026-04-01T02:00Z - 2026-04-01T06:00Z. Auto-monitoring enabled.

li: Edge cases to call out in RFC: long-context sessions (KV warm-up causing latency spikes), tokenizer diffs impacting rerank, and embedding schema/backward-compat issues — we'll need dedicated regression slices for each.

ajay: Plan: PRD draft by EOD Fri, infra prototype + config in staging early next week, experiment infra ready + canary next Wed. I'll create JIRA tasks for rollout, monitoring, and pin expiry automation. :white_check_mark:

sara: Owners: ajay (infra + rollout), li (metrics + analysis), ben (power analysis/sample size), marta (runbook + SRE approvals). I'll upload PRD draft here once done: <https://redwood.internal/docs/prd/v2-1-rollout>
